messages:
Ibrahim (CS): Quick note from PulseMed onboarding this morning — heard the same three asks from finance, security, and mobile eng. worried this could slow adoption. tagging @Jo @Riley

Jo (Product): paste the asks and any verbatim customer lines pls. rough priority is fine.

Ibrahim (CS): short list: 1) In-Console cost attribution per-feature/route (today only via exports) — procurement needs it to do internal chargebacks. 2) Per-endpoint feature toggles to block unvetted model variants for PHI endpoints (security ask). 3) Better onboarding docs + template prompts for clinical use-cases (customers are re-creating prompt sets).

Riley (PM): my initial read: 1 is medium-effort (backend + UI), 2 is larger (RBAC & routing + audit), 3 is low effort content + sample repo (quick win).

Tanya (AE): renewal is 2025-05-20; PulseMed said procurement wants per-feature cost before they sign. flagged as budget-sensitive.

Ibrahim (CS): sample quote CSV I pulled from notes:

Ibrahim (CS): ```
customer,ask,impact,quote
PulseMed,cost_per_feature,finance needs chargebacks,"We need line-item billing per workflow to allocate costs"
PulseMed,endpoint_toggle,security must block variants,"Can't expose experimental models on patient-facing endpoints"
PulseMed,onboard_templates,devs wasting time,"We rebuild clinical prompt sets each time, need starter templates"
```

triage-bot: Auto-summary created and tagged: [cost_attribution, endpoint_toggles, onboarding_templates]. Linked issue PROD-Triage-900.

Jo (Product): let's treat onboarding_templates as a P0 quick win (docs + repo). Cost attribution -> P2; endpoint toggles -> P3 pending security scoping.

Riley (PM): I'll open PROD-Triage-900 and add estimates: onboarding_templates -> 2d content sprint, cost_attribution -> 3 wks eng + UI, endpoint_toggles -> discovery next quarter.

Ibrahim (CS): I'll collect exact procurement language and example invoice rows from PulseMed and drop into the ticket by Thu.

Tanya (AE): I'll prep a renewal note for CSM and flag if Product moves the templates forward.

Jo (Product): add to roadmap sync agenda this week. if we ship templates fast it might help close renewal. :thumbsup:

Ibrahim (CS): action items: Ibrahim capture procurement phrasing + invoice rows; Riley open PROD-Triage-900; Jo add to roadmap; Tanya prep renewal note. looping back with artifacts. :eyes:
